content: This is another extractive RC model that benefits from the recent advance in pretrained general language encoders BIBREF24 , BIBREF25 . In our work, we select the BERT model BIBREF25 which has achieved the best performance on SQuAD. In our experiments, we use the PyTorch reimplementation of the uncased base model. The batch size is set as 12 and we fine-tune the model for 2 epochs with learning rate 3e-5.
